name.en: Zhu Wen founds the Later Liang

summary.zh: 朱温废唐哀帝，自立为帝，国号梁，都汴州。唐朝正式灭亡，五代十国开始。
summary.en: Zhu Wen deposed Emperor Ai of Tang and crowned himself Emperor of Liang, capital Bianzhou. The Tang dynasty fell, beginning the Five Dynasties period.

sources.title: 《资治通鉴》
sources.author: 司马光
sources.note: 卷二百六十六·后梁太祖开平元年

name.en: Wang Jian founds the Former Shu

summary.zh: 王建据西川称帝，国号蜀，史称前蜀。
summary.en: Wang Jian crowned himself Emperor of Shu in western Sichuan; known as the Former Shu.

summary.zh: 后唐庄宗李存勖率军奇袭汴州，后梁末帝朱友贞自杀，后梁灭亡。后唐迁都洛阳。
summary.en: Li Cunxu of Later Tang raided Bianzhou; Later Liang's final emperor Zhu Youzhen committed suicide. Later Tang moved capital to Luoyang.

summary.zh: 后唐命郭崇韬、李岌率军伐蜀，前蜀后主王衍出降，前蜀立国 18 年而亡。
summary.en: Later Tang sent Guo Chongtao and Li Ji to conquer Shu; Former Shu's final ruler Wang Yan surrendered.

sources.title: 《旧五代史·世袭列传·李茂贞传》附
sources.author: 薛居正等

sources.title: 《资治通鉴》
sources.author: 司马光
sources.note: 卷二百七十四·后唐同光三年

name.en: Shi Jingtang founds the Later Jin

summary.zh: 后唐河东节度使石敬瑭以燕云十六州割让辽（契丹），借兵灭后唐，自立为帝，建后晋，都汴州。
summary.en: Shi Jingtang, Hedong military commissioner of Later Tang, ceded the Sixteen Prefectures of Yan-Yun to the Liao and enlisted Khitan aid to overthrow Later Tang; founded Later Jin at Bianzhou.

summary.zh: 杨吴权臣徐知诰（后改名李昪）废吴帝杨溥自立，国号齐，都金陵。次年改国号唐，史称南唐。
summary.en: Yang Wu's regent Xu Zhigao (later Li Bian) deposed Emperor Yang Pu and founded a new state at Jinling, initially named Qi, renamed Tang the next year.

summary.zh: 南唐趁闽内乱派兵南下，闽亡。南唐疆域达于福建。
summary.en: Southern Tang exploited civil war in Min to invade; Min fell. Southern Tang's territory extended into Fujian.

sources.title: 《资治通鉴》
sources.author: 司马光
sources.note: 卷二百八十五·后晋开运二年

summary.zh: 辽太宗耶律德光率军南下灭后晋，一度占据汴州，改国号为辽（936 年已从契丹改辽）。中原大乱。
summary.en: Liao Emperor Taizong Yelü Deguang invaded, destroyed Later Jin, and briefly occupied Bianzhou.

name.en: Liu Zhiyuan founds the Later Han

summary.zh: 辽军北撤后，后晋河东节度使刘知远入汴州称帝，建后汉，五代中最短的王朝。
summary.en: After Liao forces withdrew north, Later Jin's Hedong commissioner Liu Zhiyuan entered Bianzhou and crowned himself founding emperor of Later Han.

name.en: Guo Wei founds the Later Zhou

summary.zh: 后汉枢密使郭威入京，废后汉隐帝，自立为帝，国号周，都汴州。五代更替至此收束。
summary.en: Later Han's privy councilor Guo Wei entered Bianzhou, deposed Emperor Yin, and founded Later Zhou.

summary.zh: 后汉高祖刘知远弟刘崇据太原称帝，国号汉，史称北汉，依附辽对抗后周。
summary.en: Liu Chong, brother of Later Han's founding emperor, crowned himself Emperor of Northern Han at Taiyuan with Liao backing.

summary.zh: 后周太祖郭威养子柴荣继位，是为后周世宗，五代最有为的君主。
summary.en: Chai Rong, adopted son of Later Zhou's founding emperor Guo Wei, ascended the throne as Emperor Shizong.

summary.zh: 北汉联合辽南下犯后周，柴荣亲征，在高平大败北汉与辽联军，奠定后周威信。
summary.en: Northern Han and Liao invaded Later Zhou; Chai Rong personally led troops and defeated the allied forces at Gaoping.

sources.title: 《资治通鉴》
sources.author: 司马光
sources.note: 卷二百九十一·后周显德元年

summary.zh: 柴荣命王景、向训率军灭后蜀，收复秦、凤、阶、成四州。
summary.en: Chai Rong sent Wang Jing and Xiang Xun to conquer Later Shu, recovering four prefectures.

name.en: Later Zhou campaigns against Southern Tang

summary.zh: 柴荣三次亲征淮南，拉锯两年，后周取淮南十四州，南唐去帝号，自称"江南国主"。
summary.en: Chai Rong personally led three campaigns in Huainan over two years; Later Zhou took fourteen prefectures, and Southern Tang's emperor demoted himself to "Lord of Jiangnan".

sources.title: 《资治通鉴》
sources.author: 司马光
sources.note: 卷二百九十二至二百九十四

summary.zh: 柴荣率军北伐辽，连克瓦桥、益津、淤口三关，取关南之地。柴荣病逝于军中，班师。
summary.en: Chai Rong's northern expedition against the Liao took three passes; he fell ill and died during the campaign.

summary.zh: 后周殿前都点检赵匡胤北上抵御辽兵，途经陈桥驿，被部下黄袍加身，回师汴州，建北宋，后周恭帝禅让。
summary.en: Zhao Kuangyin, commander of Later Zhou's imperial guard, was proclaimed emperor by his troops at Chenqiao on the way north; he returned to Bianzhou and founded the Northern Song.

place.zh: 湖北江陵 / 湖南长沙

summary.zh: 北宋以讨伐张文表为名借道荆南（南平），先取荆南，再南下湖南；所灭为据湖南的武平政权。马楚已于 951 年为南唐所灭。
summary.en: Northern Song used the Zhang Wenbiao revolt as a pretext to march through Jingnan, took Jingnan, then moved into Hunan against the Wuping regime (Ma Chu had already fallen to Southern Tang in 951).

summary.zh: 北宋命王全斌、崔彦进率军从北路入蜀，刘光义从东路，两路夹击，后蜀孟昶出降。
summary.en: Northern Song sent Wang Quanbin via the north and Liu Guangyi via the east in a two-pronged invasion of Later Shu; Meng Chang surrendered.

summary.zh: 北宋命潘美率军南下，水陆并进，攻破广州，南汉后主刘鋹出降。
summary.en: Northern Song sent Pan Mei south with a combined land and water force; Guangzhou fell and Southern Han's final ruler Liu Chang surrendered.

summary.zh: 北宋命曹彬、潘美率军围金陵，开宝八年十一月城破，南唐后主李煜出降，被俘至汴州。
summary.en: Northern Song's Cao Bin and Pan Mei besieged Jinling; the city fell in winter 975, and Southern Tang's final ruler Li Yu surrendered.

summary.zh: 吴越国王钱俶见南唐已亡，大势已去，纳土归宋，兵不血刃，两浙和平统一。
summary.en: Seeing Southern Tang destroyed, King Qian Chu of Wuyue surrendered peacefully; Zhejiang was reunited without fighting.

summary.zh: 宋太宗赵光义亲征太原，先败辽援军，后破太原城。北汉末帝刘继元出降，五代十国终结。
summary.en: Emperor Taizong Zhao Guangyi of Northern Song conquered Taiyuan, defeated Liao reinforcements, and Northern Han's final ruler surrendered. The Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period ended.

summary.zh: 唐景福二年（893），钱镠被任为镇海军节度使、润州刺史，唐廷承认其对浙江西道的统治；浙东仍属董昌，两浙尚未合一。
summary.en: In 893 the Tang court appointed Qian Liu Zhenhai jiedushi and governor of Runzhou, recognizing his control of western Zhejiang; eastern Zhejiang remained under Dong Chang.

sources.title: 《新五代史》卷六十七《吴越世家》
sources.author: 欧阳修

sources.title: 《旧五代史》卷一百三十三《世袭列传二·钱镠》
sources.author: 薛居正等

sources.title: 《十国春秋》卷七十七《吴越一·武肃王》
sources.author: 吴任臣

name.en: Yang Xingmi enfeoffed as Prince of Wu

summary.zh: 唐天复二年（902），杨行密受封吴王，据江淮。
summary.en: Yang Xingmi was enfeoffed as Prince of Wu, establishing Yang Wu.

summary.zh: 后梁开平三年（909），王审知受封闽王，据福建。
summary.en: Wang Shenzhi was enfeoffed as King of Min, controlling Fujian.

summary.zh: 后梁贞明三年（917），刘龑称帝，国号汉，都广州。
summary.en: Liu Yan crowned himself Emperor of Han at Guangzhou.

name.en: Qian Liu declares King of Wuyue

summary.zh: 后唐同光元年（923），钱镠受封吴越国王。
summary.en: Qian Liu was enfeoffed as King of Wuyue.

summary.zh: 后唐同光二年（924），高季兴受封南平王，都江陵。
summary.en: Gao Jixing was enfeoffed as King of Nanping at Jiangling.

summary.zh: 后唐天成二年（927），马殷受封楚王，都长沙。
summary.en: Ma Yin was enfeoffed as King of Chu at Changsha.

summary.zh: 后唐庄宗李存勖为乱兵所杀，李嗣源继位。
summary.en: Later Tang Emperor Zhuangzong was killed in a mutiny; Li Siyuan took the throne.

summary.zh: 石敬瑭为换辽支持灭后唐，割让燕云十六州，中原失去长城屏障。
summary.en: Shi Jingtang ceded Sixteen Prefectures to the Liao, removing the Great Wall defense.

name.en: Liao Emperor Taizong dies on retreat

summary.zh: 耶律德光北撤途中病逝于杀胡林，辽内斗，未能再入中原。
summary.en: Yelü Deguang died at Shahulin on his retreat; Liao succession struggles followed.

name.en: Later Yin of Han executes Guo Wei's family

summary.zh: 后汉隐帝诛枢密使郭威家眷，郭威起兵反汉。
summary.en: Later Han Emperor Yin executed Guo Wei's family; Guo Wei rebelled.

summary.zh: 后周太祖郭威颁令减免赋税、整顿吏治、抑佛。
summary.en: Guo Wei reduced taxes, improved administration, and suppressed excessive Buddhist establishments.

name.en: Chai Rong expands guard, south-first strategy

summary.zh: 柴荣选天下精锐充实"殿前诸班"，并制定先南后北统一方针。
summary.en: Chai Rong selected elite troops for the imperial guard and established a "south first, north later" unification strategy.

summary.zh: 柴荣颁《抑佛诏》，停无名僧尼、毁私建佛寺、收铜铸钱。
summary.en: Chai Rong's edict restricted unregulated clergy and seized copper for coinage.

name.en: Zhou siege of Shouzhou; Liu Ranshan

summary.zh: 柴荣首次征淮南围寿州，南唐刘仁赡守城近一年，城破后不食而死。
summary.en: Chai Rong's first Huainan campaign besieged Shouzhou; Liu Ranshan held out nearly a year and died after the city fell.

name.zh: 清流关之战·赵匡胤崭露头角
name.en: Battle of Qingliu Pass; Zhao Kuangyin rises

summary.zh: 后周殿前都虞候赵匡胤率奇兵夜袭清流关，斩南唐大将皇甫晖，一战成名。
summary.en: Zhao Kuangyin led a surprise night attack, killing Huangfu Hui and rising to fame.

name.zh: 后周取凤州·后蜀失秦岭

summary.zh: 后周取凤州、文州，后蜀失去秦岭要地。
summary.en: Zhou took Fengzhou and Wenzhou; Later Shu lost strategic passes in the Qinling.

summary.zh: 李璟继位后，南唐文化达鼎盛，为十国之冠。
summary.en: Under Li Jing, Southern Tang became the cultural center of the Ten Kingdoms.

name.en: Chai Rong dies; young emperor ascends

summary.zh: 柴荣病逝，年仅三十九岁，七岁幼帝柴宗训继位，孤儿寡母，兵权落于赵匡胤。
summary.en: Chai Rong died aged 39; his 7-year-old son succeeded. Zhao Kuangyin controlled the military.

name.zh: 陈桥兵变·黄袍加身（通行说法）

summary.zh: 通行说法：殿前都点检赵匡胤北上抵御辽兵，途经陈桥驿被部下黄袍加身。另有异说：兵变乃赵匡胤自编自演。
summary.en: Received account: Zhao proclaimed emperor by troops. Alternative: mutiny was staged.

summary.zh: 宰相赵普献"先南后北、先易后难"统一方略。
summary.en: Chancellor Zhao Pu advised "south first, north later; easy first, hard later."

summary.zh: 赵匡胤设晚宴解除将领兵权，加强中央集权。（史实存疑，通行说法）
summary.en: Zhao Kuangyin's famous banquet released generals from command. (Received account.)

name.en: Meng Chang of Later Shu surrenders

summary.zh: 后蜀后主孟昶出降，被俘至汴州，次年病逝（疑为赵匡胤毒杀）。
summary.en: Meng Chang surrendered and was taken to Bianzhou.

summary.zh: 北宋在采石矶架长江浮桥，大军渡江直逼金陵。
summary.en: Northern Song built a pontoon bridge at Caishiji to cross the Yangtze.

summary.zh: 李煜被俘至汴州，封"违命侯"。三年后因唱《虞美人》为宋太宗毒杀。
summary.en: Li Yu titled "Lord of Disobedience" and was later poisoned for singing "Yu Meiren."

name.en: Battle of Gaoliang River, Song-Liao standoff

summary.zh: 灭北汉后赵光义北伐辽收复燕云，高梁河惨败，乘驴车南逃。此后二十五年宋辽对峙。
summary.en: Zhao Guangyi invaded Liao after Northern Han; defeated at Gaoliang River, fled in a donkey cart. 25-year standoff ensued.

name.en: Later Liang vs. Jin at Luzhou

summary.zh: 后梁与李存勖晋军在潞州相持数年，为后唐灭后梁埋下伏笔。
summary.en: Years of standoff between Later Liang and Li Cunxu's Jin at Luzhou.

name.zh: 后唐灭后梁·胡柳陂之战

summary.zh: 李存勖与后梁军激战胡柳陂，虽胜但损失惨重，是灭梁前的关键一战。
summary.en: Li Cunxu defeated Later Liang at Huliu Slope, a costly but decisive victory.

name.en: Former Shu's last ruler Wang Yan

summary.zh: 王建死后，子王衍继位，荒淫无度，前蜀迅速衰落。
summary.en: After Wang Jian's death, Wang Yan ruled extravagantly; Former Shu declined rapidly.

name.en: Later Jin maintains peace with Liao

summary.zh: 石敬瑭死后，后晋新帝石重贵与辽关系恶化，辽太宗决意南侵。
summary.en: After Shi Jingtang's death, Later Jin relations with Liao deteriorated.

name.en: Liao invades south; Battle of Chanzhou

summary.zh: 辽太宗耶律德光第一次大举南侵，后晋抵抗有功，但国力耗尽。
summary.en: Yelü Deguang's first major invasion of Later Jin.

summary.zh: 吴越钱氏世代兴修水利、治理太湖水系、修筑海塘，两浙富庶。
summary.en: The Qian family built irrigation networks and sea walls, making Wuyue prosperous.

summary.zh: 后唐西川节度使孟知祥据蜀称帝，国号蜀，史称后蜀。
summary.en: Meng Zhixiang declared emperor of Shu in Sichuan; known as Later Shu.

sources.title: 《旧五代史·世袭列传·孟知祥传》
sources.author: 薛居正等

name.en: Li Jing ascends Southern Tang throne

summary.zh: 南唐烈祖李昪卒，子李璟继位，是为元宗。南唐文化达于鼎盛，但军事转弱。
summary.en: Li Bian died; his son Li Jing succeeded. Culture flourished but military weakened.

name.zh: 柴荣整顿财政·宽减赋税

summary.zh: 柴荣颁《均田图》与《定租赋诏》，平均田赋，减轻农民负担。
summary.en: Chai Rong issued land equalization edicts, reducing peasant burdens.

name.en: Chai Rong's northern expedition: three passes

summary.zh: 柴荣北伐，连克瓦桥、益津、淤口三关，辽军不战而退，关南尽归后周。
summary.en: Chai Rong took three passes without major battle; all of Guan'nan returned to Zhou.

name.zh: 北宋设枢密院·二府三司

summary.zh: 北宋确立枢密院掌兵、中书门下掌政的二府制，加强中央集权，防止唐末藩镇重演。
summary.en: Northern Song established dual-track governance: Privy Council for military, Secretariat for civil.

name.en: Liu Chang of Southern Han surrenders

summary.zh: 潘美率军南下，水陆并进，攻破广州。南汉后主刘鋹出降，被封为"恩赦侯"。
summary.en: Pan Mei conquered Guangzhou; Liu Chang surrendered and was titled "Lord of Grace."

name.zh: 北宋灭荆南·江陵兵不血刃

summary.zh: 宋军借道荆南之际，高继冲主动纳土归宋，荆南兵不血刃而亡。
summary.en: Gao Jichong surrendered Jingnan peacefully when Song forces passed through.

name.en: Song annexes Hunan and captures Zhou Baoquan

summary.zh: 宋军平定荆南后南下，武平内乱（张文表之乱）为宋所乘，宋执武平主周保权，湖南入宋。马楚已于 951 年为南唐所灭，此役所灭为武平。
summary.en: After Jingnan, Song moved south, exploited Wuping’s internal revolt, captured Zhou Baoquan and annexed Hunan. Ma Chu had already fallen in 951; the regime conquered here was Wuping.

name.zh: 曹彬围金陵·水陆军合围

summary.zh: 北宋曹彬为帅，水陆两路合围金陵，李煜坚守一年。
summary.en: Cao Bin's Song forces besieged Jinling by land and water for a year.

summary.zh: 南唐亡后，吴越国王钱俶见大势已去，纳土归宋，两浙和平统一。
summary.en: After Southern Tang fell, Qian Chu surrendered Wuyue peacefully.

summary.zh: 宋太宗赵光义亲征太原，败辽援军，城破，北汉末帝刘继元出降。
summary.en: Emperor Taizong conquered Taiyuan, defeated Liao reinforcements; Liu Jiyuan surrendered.

summary.zh: 杨行密据江淮，受封吴王，奠定杨吴国基。
summary.en: Yang Xingmi took control of Jianghuai and was enfeoffed as Prince of Wu.

sources.title: 《旧五代史·世袭列传·杨行密传》
sources.author: 薛居正等

summary.zh: 杨吴权臣徐知诰（后改名李昪）废吴帝杨溥，建立南唐。
summary.en: Xu Zhigao (later Li Bian) replaced Yang Wu and founded Southern Tang.

summary.zh: 钱镠受后梁封吴越王，建国两浙。
summary.en: Qian Liu was enfeoffed as Prince of Wuyue by Later Liang.

summary.zh: 王审知据福建，受后梁封闽王，发展海外贸易。
summary.en: Wang Shenzhi ruled Fujian, promoted overseas trade.

sources.title: 《旧五代史·世袭列传·王审知传》
sources.author: 薛居正等

summary.zh: 刘龑（后改名刘䶮）在广州称帝，国号汉，史称南汉。
summary.en: Liu Yan (later Liu Ang) declared emperor in Guangzhou; known as Southern Han.

summary.zh: 马殷据湖南，受后唐封楚国王，以茶马贸易致富。
summary.en: Ma Yin ruled Hunan, famous for horse-tea trade.

summary.zh: 高季兴受后唐封南平王，据江陵，以劫掠过路商队闻名，被称为"高赖子"。
summary.en: Gao Jixing known as "Gao the Scoundrel" for robbing passing caravans.

sources.title: 《旧五代史·世袭列传·高季兴传》
sources.author: 薛居正等

summary.zh: 王建据蜀称帝，国号蜀，史称前蜀，励精图治。
summary.en: Wang Jian declared emperor in Sichuan; Former Shu was initially well-governed.

summary.zh: 孟知祥卒，子孟昶继位，前期勤政，后期奢靡。
summary.en: Meng Zhixiang died; his son Meng Chang ruled Later Shu for 31 years.

sources.title: 《旧五代史·世袭列传·孟知祥传》
sources.author: 薛居正等

summary.zh: 后汉亡，刘崇据太原称帝，国号汉，史称北汉，结辽抗周抗宋。
summary.en: After Later Han fell, Liu Chong declared emperor at Taiyuan; Northern Han allied with Liao.

summary.zh: 李昪在位期间减税安民、兴水利、开科取士，南唐成为十国中最富庶者。
summary.en: Li Bian reduced taxes, built waterworks; Southern Tang became richest of the Ten Kingdoms.

sources.title: 《资治通鉴》
sources.author: 司马光
sources.note: 卷二百八十五至二百九十一

summary.zh: 李璟、李煜父子与冯延巳等开创南唐词派，"春花秋月何时了"成千古绝唱。
summary.en: Li Jing, Li Yu and Feng Yansi founded the Southern Tang lyric school.

summary.zh: 南唐趁闽国内乱出兵，攻破福州，闽亡。但闽地旋即被吴越抢占。
summary.en: Southern Tang conquered Min during its civil war.

summary.zh: 马殷死后诸子争位，马楚由盛转衰，被南唐所灭。
summary.en: After Ma Yin's death, succession struggles weakened Ma Chu.

name.zh: 后唐灭前蜀·郭崇韬伐蜀

summary.zh: 后唐郭崇韬率军伐蜀，仅用七十日攻破成都，前蜀亡。
summary.en: Guo Chongtao conquered Former Shu in only 70 days.

summary.zh: 朱温废唐哀帝自立，国号梁，史称后梁。延续三百年的大唐正式灭亡。
summary.en: Zhu Wen deposed the last Tang emperor; Tang dynasty ended.

name.zh: 石敬瑭反后唐·潞王自焚
name.en: Shi Jingtang rebels; Later Tang falls

summary.zh: 石敬瑭结辽反唐，后唐末帝李从珂自焚，后唐亡。
summary.en: Shi Jingtang allied with Liao to overthrow Later Tang.

summary.zh: 朱温称帝后册封各地军阀为郡王，吴越、杨吴、前蜀、马楚、南汉、闽等皆受封，十国格局初定。
summary.en: Zhu Wen enfeoffed regional warlords; pattern of Ten Kingdoms set.

name.en: Song forces breach Jinling; Li Yu surrenders

summary.zh: 宋军围城一年余，金陵城破，南唐后主李煜肉袒出降，被封"违命侯"。
summary.en: Jinling fell after a year's siege; Li Yu surrendered.

summary.zh: 辽朝疆域东至渤海、西至阿尔泰山，女真各部皆臣属。
summary.en: Liao controlled vast steppe; Jurchen tribes were vassals.

name.zh: 刘言复湖南·武平据楚地
name.en: Liu Yan retakes Hunan: the Wuping regime

summary.zh: 南唐灭楚后以边镐镇长沙，楚地将领不服。952 年朗州将刘言遣王逵、周行逢等攻长沙，边镐弃城走，湖南复归本地军将，此后周行逢据之，史称武平。
summary.en: After conquering Chu, Southern Tang garrisoned Changsha under Bian Gao, but local commanders refused allegiance. In 952 Liu Yan of Langzhou sent Wang Kui and Zhou Xingfeng against Changsha; Bian Gao abandoned the city and Hunan returned to local commanders, later held by Zhou Xingfeng — the Wuping regime.

name.zh: 留从效据泉漳·清源军自立
name.en: Liu Congxiao takes Quanzhou and Zhangzhou

summary.zh: 闽亡后，泉州将留从效逐南唐所署官员，据泉、漳二州，受南唐节度名义而实自专，是为清源军。
summary.en: After Min’s fall, the Quanzhou commander Liu Congxiao expelled Southern Tang officials and held Quanzhou and Zhangzhou under nominal Southern Tang suzerainty — the Qingyuan regime.

name.zh: 南唐攻福州·吴越援李仁达
name.en: Southern Tang attacks Fuzhou; Wuyue intervenes

summary.zh: 南唐遣军攻福州，李仁达求援于吴越；吴越泛海赴援，南唐军大败，福州得以继续自立。
summary.en: Southern Tang attacked Fuzhou; Li Renda appealed to Wuyue, whose forces crossed the sea and defeated the Southern Tang army, leaving Fuzhou independent for the time being.

name.zh: 李仁达归附吴越·福州入吴越

summary.zh: 947 年李仁达归附吴越，吴越遣张筠等接管福州，福州自此属吴越，直至 978 年纳土归宋。
summary.en: In 947 Li Renda submitted to Wuyue, which sent Zhang Yun to take over Fuzhou; the city remained Wuyue’s until 978.

name.en: Chen Hongjin submits Quanzhou and Zhangzhou to Song

summary.zh: 978 年清源军节度使陈洪进纳土，泉、漳二州归宋；同年吴越钱俶亦纳土，南方割据至此基本结束。
summary.en: In 978 Chen Hongjin submitted Quanzhou and Zhangzhou to Song; Wuyue’s Qian Chu submitted the same year, ending the southern separatist regimes.
